title: Vendor API - Latency
description: ClickHouse-backed vendor latency percentiles and slow endpoint analysis.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY vendor_id

list.name: endpoint
list.label: Endpoint
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT endpoint FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY endpoint

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.50)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint'
SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint'
SELECT quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint'
SELECT max(latency_ms) AS max_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint'

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: P50 / P95 / P99 All Selected Traffic

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, quantile(0.50)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, count() AS timeouts FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'TIMEOUT' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

SELECT vendor_id, endpoint, count() AS calls, quantile(0.50)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99_ms, max(latency_ms) AS max_ms, countIf(status = 'TIMEOUT') AS timeouts FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND endpoint LIKE '$endpoint' GROUP BY vendor_id, endpoint ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 50
